content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00229, SRS_BSW_00347 For each VariationPointProxy which bindingTime = preCompileTime the RTE Configuration Header File shall contain a definition of a Condition Value Macro in the RTE PreBuild Data Set Contract Phase and RTE PreBuild Data Set Generation Phase 626 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 #define SchM_SysCon_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<name> <value><suffix> Where <bsnp> is the BSW Scheduler Name Prefix according [SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594], <vi> is the vendorId of the BSW module, <ai> is the vendorApiInfix of the BSW module, <name> is the short name of the VariationPointProxy <value> is the evaluated value of the AttributeValueVariationPoint or Con- ditionByFormula and <suffix> is set according to [SWS_Rte_03619]. The sub part in squared brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module (See [SWS_Rte_07528]).
